faqs.q: What services does Nexbridge Solutions offer?
faqs.a: We offer education and study abroad, immigration and visa, business and corporate, tax and legal documentation, travel and tourism, and language and test preparation services.

faqs.q: How do I book a consultation?
faqs.a: Use the Book a Consultation page to choose a service and preferred time, or send us an inquiry through any service page. Our team will confirm with you.
Yes. We offer consultations in our office, by phone, by WhatsApp call or online.
No honest consultant can guarantee an admission, visa or scholarship, because those decisions belong to universities and authorities. We guarantee careful, transparent work on your case.

faqs.q: Which country is best for me?
faqs.a: It depends on your field, budget, academic profile and long-term plans. Our counselors compare options with you in your first consultation.

faqs.q: When should I start my application?
faqs.a: Ideally 9 to 12 months before your intended intake, to leave time for tests, applications, scholarships and the visa.

faqs.q: Can I study abroad without IELTS?
faqs.a: Some universities accept other English tests or evidence such as English-medium education. We check your options.
Yes. We identify scholarships you are eligible for and help you prepare strong applications.

faqs.q: Can you help after a visa refusal?
faqs.a: Yes. We review the refusal letter and your previous application, and advise whether and how to reapply.

faqs.q: Are embassy fees included in your service?
faqs.a: No. Embassy, visa centre and government fees are paid separately by the applicant.

faqs.q: How long does a visa take?
faqs.a: Processing times vary by country, visa type and season. We advise you on current timelines when you apply.

faqs.q: Do freelancers need to file tax returns?
faqs.a: Yes. Freelancers with taxable income should register for NTN and file annual returns.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a company and a firm?
faqs.a: A company is a separate legal entity registered with SECP. A firm is a partnership registered with the provincial Registrar of Firms.

faqs.q: Can overseas Pakistanis register a business in Pakistan?
faqs.a: In many cases, yes. Requirements depend on the business structure and your residency status.

faqs.q: Can you help with a tourist visa and the trip together?
faqs.a: Yes. Our visa and travel teams work together so your itinerary and visa application match.
